headline: Proposed FY27 funding timeline and contract updates for Anniversary Hill and Scott Tower.
summary: A proposed FY27 funding timeline is on the agenda, along with contract updates for Anniversary Hill and Scott Tower. Other items include an eligibility discussion, a Historic Commission update, and a Community Preservation Plan update.

location: Remote, with access link in the meeting notice
plain_text:
Holyoke, Massachusetts
Notice of Committee Meeting
There will be a public meeting of the Community Preservation Act Committee
August 12, 2026 at 6:00 P.M
Please Note: The meeting is being held remotely in keeping with Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025
for remote/ hybrid meeting signed into law by Governor Healey on March 28, 2025.This
meeting notice contains the link below providing the public with remote access.
Agenda:
Review & Approve Minutes from June CPA Draft Minutes 6.3.26
Guest: Maggie Herlihy, Interim Director of Conservation and Sustainability Anniversary Hill &
Scott Tower Contract Updates:
FY26 Contract Updates
Historic Commission Update:
Eligibility Discussion:
Proposed FY27 Funding Timeline: Funding Timeline FY27 Outline
Project Updates:
Old Business:
Website Migration: CPA pages on COH Website
In-person Meetings
Community Preservation Plan Update
Note: The matters listed on this agenda are those reasonably anticipated by the Chairperson
which may be discussed at the meeting. Not all items listed may in fact be discussed and other
items not listed may also be brought up for discussion to the extent permitted by law. In
addition, this agenda is subject to change within 48 hours prior to the meeting date. Also please
note that the Chair and the meeting host reserve the right to remove any individual from the
meeting who disrupts the discussion.
